name: 176-remove-child-management-resources
command:
helm uninstall kof-child -n kof --wait --timeout 3m
kubectl -n kcm-system delete configmap kof-management kof-cluster-config-managed-cluster-01 --ignore-not-found
source /home/ubuntu/qa-week1/ingest.env
test -n "$CERT_DIR"
rm -rf -- "$CERT_DIR"
rm -f /tmp/managed-cluster-01.kubeconfig /tmp/kof-values.json /tmp/kof-annotation-before.yaml /tmp/kof-ingest-values.yaml
stdout:
release "kof-child" uninstalled
configmap "kof-management" deleted from kcm-system namespace
configmap "kof-cluster-config-managed-cluster-01" deleted from kcm-system namespace
